events.title: 미들즈브러 sign Slovakian midfielder Vladimír Kinder from 슬로반 브라티슬라바 for £1 million.
Manager Leo Beenhakker is named technical director at Dutch club 피테서 and replaced as manager by 스파르타 로테르담 head coach Henk ten Cate .
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 are rocked by the resignation of manager 케빈 키건 , who explained, "I feel I have taken this club as far as I can."

The 1995 Football League Cup Final participants (리버풀 and 볼턴 원더러스) are eliminated from the same tournament at the quarter-final stage by 미들즈브러 and 윔블던 respectively. This is the furthest the Dons have ever progressed in the League Cup.

블랙번 로버스 continue their revival with a 4–0 home win over 코번트리 시티. 미들즈브러's relegation worries are deepened with a 1–0 home defeat to 사우샘프턴, and later this week their survival battle could be toughened by a points deduction.
요크 시티 , who knocked 에버턴 out of the League Cup this season and 맨체스터 유나이티드 last season, later lost to Hednesford Town in a 1-0 FA Cup loss at Keys Park .

미들즈브러, bottom of the Premier League, are deducted three points for cancelling their fixture at 블랙번 로버스 last month. They are also fined £50,000. Striker Fabrizio Ravanelli claims that his club will now "almost certainly" be relegated. Ravanelli's fellow countryman Gianluca Festa joins 미들즈브러 from 인테르 on the same day for £2.7 million.
케니 달글리시 is named as 뉴캐슬 유나이티드's new manager.
레스터 시티 pay £1.6 million for 옥스퍼드 유나이티드's 28-year-old defender Matt Elliott .

케니 달글리시 begins his reign as 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 manager with a 2–2 draw at 사우샘프턴, costing his own side two valuable points as he looks to become the first manager to win the English league title with three clubs, while a point for 사우샘프턴 gives their survival battle a boost.

A major upset in the FA Cup third round replay sees 렉섬 win 1–0 against 웨스트햄 유나이티드 at Upton Park after drawing the first match 1–1 at the Racecourse Ground , sparking a pitch invasion. However, Hednesford Town's luck finally runs out when they lose 3–2 to 미들즈브러 in the fourth round clash at the Riverside Stadium , while a late equaliser for 윔블던 forces a replay for 맨체스터 유나이티드.
리버풀's bid for a second double is ended as they are defeated 4–2 by 첼시 in the fourth round replay at Stamford Bridge.

리버풀 are beaten by both 레인저스 and AC 밀란 in a six-a-side tournament at the Amsterdam Arena ; the Glasgow club's England international Paul Gascoigne limps out of the same competition, putting into doubt his participation in the national side's Wembley match with Italy in February.
코번트리 시티 boost their defence with the acquisition of Gary Breen from 버밍엄 시티 for £2.5million.

January ends with 맨체스터 유나이티드 now top of the Premier League and unbeaten in it since early November. 아스널, 리버풀 and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 are their nearest contenders, while 윔블던 have endured a slight setback but have two games in hand to muscle in on the top four. 미들즈브러's three-point deduction for cancelling a league fixture in December leaves them bottom of the table, while caretaker-manager Stuart Pearce has guided 노팅엄 포리스트 out of the drop zone with three wins this month, 사우샘프턴 remain in the bottom three, and 블랙번 로버스 have finally climbed clear of the drop zone at the expense of 웨스트햄 유나이티드. 볼턴 원더러스 have extended their lead at the top of Division One to 11 points, their nearest challengers being 셰필드 유나이티드 and 반즐리. The top six is completed by 울버햄프턴 원더러스, 노리치 시티 and 스토크 시티.
